subject: ParcelCo MAP: final decision window and document chain for signature
messages:
From: Sarah Wu <sarah.wu@parcelco.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: ParcelCo Legal <contracts@parcelco.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ParcelCo - Final MAP & Go/No-Go window

Karthik,

Thanks for walking through the evaluation plan yesterday. We ran the internal readiness check this morning and have a narrow window to lock the start date before our fiscal quarter close. To keep timing predictable for our ops and procurement teams, can you confirm the following by EOW next week?

1) Final mutual action plan (MAP) PDF with exact owner names and signoff steps (we need this for procurement).
2) Target dates for legal review + e-sign (we have one senior exec who needs to approve on their side).
3) A clear go/no-go checklist so our CTO can greenlight the pilot on the day of signature.

Attached: ParcelCo_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP with proposed milestones + responsibilities).

Preferred start date from our side: Monday, Oct 11, 2026. That gives us one week after signature for provisioning and kickoff prep. If any critical approval will push the signature past Oct 9, flag it — we may need an interim technical access window.

Can you loop in whoever from your legal and onboarding teams needs to be on the signoff path?

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Wu
Head of Platform Partnerships
ParcelCo

---
Attachment: ParcelCo_MAP_v3.pdf (PDF, 24 KB)
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ParcelCo - Final MAP & Go/No-Go window

Sarah — thanks, and great to see ParcelCo locking dates. Quick read-through of the attached MAP — looks solid.

High-level plan from our side:
- Legal review window: we can turn contract redlines in ~48 hours once we have a single redline file from ParcelCo Legal. Lauren, who should I expect to receive redlines from on ParcelCo's side?
- DocuSign routing: standard Redwood exec + finance + customer signers. We can pre-fill signer order once ParcelCo confirms the signing authority.
- Onboarding kickoff: engineering onboarding session scheduled 48 hours after signature; proposed start date Oct 11 is doable if we sign by Oct 9 EOD PT.

Requested items from ParcelCo to hit Oct 9:
- Final redline (or confirmation to proceed on your standard terms) by COB Oct 4 PT.
- Exec approval note (one-line email) from your sponsor by Oct 6.

I'll attach our final MAP with internal owners annotated and a short go/no-go checklist (see attachment). Monica will lead onboarding; Lauren will lead legal review.

Next steps: Lauren will review the MAP + proposed terms and call out anything that could delay the DocuSign timeline. Monica will prepare the onboarding runbook and a short checklist your CTO can use to approve live access.

K

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com

Subject: Re: ParcelCo - Final MAP & Go/No-Go window

Hi all — looping in on the legal side. Thanks for the MAP, Sarah; I annotated the key contractual items that typically add time: data residency clause, SSO/SCIM language, liability cap language, and the privacy/data processing addendum.

Summary and timeline estimate from Legal:
- If ParcelCo sends a single consolidated redline (Word or PDF comments) by COB Oct 4, we can complete a review and produce a counter within ~48 hours (target delivery Oct 6).
- If there are significant term changes (e.g., new residency or indemnity terms), we may need an additional 24–48 hours.
- DocuSign routing: once terms are agreed, I will pre-sequence signers: ParcelCo exec -> Redwood finance -> Redwood exec. DocuSign envelope can be sent same day if countersigned PDF is approved.

Go/no-go checklist (draft):
- Legal: final countersigned contract in DocuSign envelope.
- Finance: billing PO or invoice schedule confirmed.
- Security: SOC 2 attestation provided (we already shared this doc last week).
- Tech: provisioning checklist complete and staging credentials tested.

If ParcelCo is able to accept Redwood's standard residency and liability language, we are on track for Oct 7 signature (Lauren to send DocuSign envelope Oct 7 morning PT). If not, please flag specific clauses so we can take them offline.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.inference.com

Thanks, Lauren—appreciate the clear breakdown. Quick updates from ParcelCo side:
- Procurement confirmed they'll accept redline set delivered by COB Oct 4 (we met that internally).
- Our Exec approver will be available to sign on Oct 6 (they wanted visibility to the countersigned contract prior to signing).
- I’m cc'ing our legal lead (contracts@parcelco.com) to queue the redline to you directly.

Two asks on the checklist:
1) Can Redwood provide a one-page "Day-0 Access" checklist that our CTO can tick the moment the DocuSign is complete? We want a lightweight technical gating list (network allowlist, API keys, initial rate limits, contact on-call).
2) If we sign Oct 7 morning PT, can you confirm provisioning that same day (staging credentials issued within 8 business hours) so we can validate before the scheduled Oct 11 start?

If both answers are yes, we will target Oct 7 signature and Oct 11 start.

Best,
Sarah
